messages:
Maria: Quick thread — thinking about color semantics for dark console charts and code snippets. The current token heatmap is too saturated and reads as "hot" even for mid values. Also the theme toggle copy (Dark vs Dim) is confusing to external users. Thoughts?
Sam: Agree on heatmap. Can we move to a perceptually-uniform scale (Viridis-ish) or a custom HCL ramp? Need to ensure contrast with #0B0F12 bg meets AA for 14px labels.
Jad: For syntax highlighting, we should avoid pure-neon blues for identifiers — causes eye strain in long sessions. Suggest we pull identifier hue toward teal and soften saturation, keep keywords warm.
Aria: Accessibility nit: legend labels are 12px / #9AA4AD on the current mocks — that’s <4.5:1 against dark bg. Either bump to 14px or increase contrast (darker #C9D4DB).
Kevin: Mockup CSS vars look helpful. Posting a quick snippet to test in the console: 
```css
:root {
  --bg: #0B0F12; /* console background */
  --text: hsl(210 8% 86%); /* primary text */
  --muted: hsl(210 6% 64%); /* secondary */
  --heat-1: hsl(210 90% 40%); /* cold */
  --heat-3: hsl(40 80% 55%); /* mid */
  --heat-5: hsl(12 85% 58%); /* hot */
}
```
Maria: Love the CSS var approach. Two other concerns: heatmap needs to keep perceptual spacing between low→mid→high on small screens, and syntax contrast needs to work for copy/paste snippets (inline code).
Sam: Patterns/textures could help low-contrast differentiation (tiny dots/diagonals) but canvas performance might suffer if we rasterize. Maybe a 1px inset border between heatmap cells is cheaper.
Aria: Also — change the toggle label to explicit copy: "Theme: Light / Dark" or "Appearance: Light / Dark". "Dim" is ambiguous for accessibility settings. And add keyboard shortcut tooltip (press T to toggle).
Jad: For colorblind checks, run deutan/protan simulations. Prefer palettes that preserve ordering even if hue shifts (i.e., luminance-driven ramps). ColorBrewer diverging palettes are a good baseline.
Maria: Plan: I’ll update the Figma with two swatches (Viridis-like and custom warm-cool ramp), adjust legend labels to 14px with stronger contrast, and add copy change for the toggle. I propose A/B rollout behind flag to 10% of users for two weeks. Any objections?
Kevin: No objections. Add a note to the rollout doc to check CPU/GPU perf for heatmap rasterization on low-end devices.
Sam: Will ping infra for perf numbers and check canvas paint times :eyes: 
Design-bot: Created issue RN-3421 with attachments and Figma links https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/console-themes (internal).
Maria: Thanks — I’ll attach updated tokens and a short test plan to RN-3421 and schedule a quick review on Friday. :thumbsup:
